newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul 3-yr bond yields end down on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Seoul 3-yr bond yields end down on bargain hunting.

text.p: South Korea's benchmark three-year corporate bond yields closed lower on Thursday on bargain hunting and buying based on the improving liquidity, dealers said.
Liquidity was high despite the central bank's absorption of 980 billion won from the banking system, they said.
But the overnight call rate rose as banks were reluctant to offer call loans ahead of the end of the first half.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.75 pct vs Wednesday's 11.90
* 3-mth CDs close at 12.00 pct vs Wednesday's 12.05
* Average overnight call at 11.57 pct vs Wednesday's 11.53
Dealers estimated that about 900 billion won was supplied by the central bank's dollar buying.
"Some institutions also bought corporates on the belief that the liquidity situation would improve from next month when a new half-year begins," said a Samsung Securities dealer.
Despite the high liquidity, the overnight call rate rose slightly as banks remained reluctant to offer call loans to adjust their positions ahead of the end of the first half.
